name: AccountPaymentMethodCard
title: Blocks/Account/AccountPaymentMethodCard
summary: The Payment method card of the Upgrade to Pro drawer: the card on file as one bordered row with the Visa plate, the last four digits and a Change action, which swaps the row for the card form until Cancel or Update. The drawer disables it while the upgrade is submitting. Built from `Card`, `Field` with `Input` and `Select`, `Alert`, `Button` and `PaymentBrand` (the monochrome card-brand plate in theme tokens).

variants.name: Editing
variants.summary: After Change: cardholder, country, number, expiry and security code over the PCI notice, with Cancel and Update stacked below sm.

variants.name: Disabled
variants.summary: While the upgrade submits, the Change action is disabled.
